about_the_game:
Step into vibrant, hand-crafted parks brimming with physics-based toys and endless possibilities. Whether you're looking to goof around with friends, master parkour, or dive into hilarious mini-games, Clayground is the all-in-one social VR playground built from the ground up for fun in VR.

(The footage below is from early alpha testing and not representative of final gameplay)

Seamless Social VR - Play Together, Effortlessly

Forget loading screens and complicated setups. Clayground is designed for instant social connection.

  • Next-Gen Matchmaking: Get playing faster with friends and new faces thanks to our next-gen matchmaking system, including age-based options for a comfortable social space.

  • Instant Groups: Create groups effortlessly and stay connected with your favorite playmates across parks.

  • Crossplay Freedom: Whether your friends are on PCVR (Steam), Quest, or PSVR 2 (date to be determined!), everyone can join the fun.

  • Effortless Park Hopping: Travel seamlessly between every park with your group of up to 8, keeping the party going without interruption.

A Physics Playground Like No Other

Experience realistic physics interactions that deliver deep gameplay possibilities.

  • So Many Toys: Each park comes packed with unique toys– from basketballs to fort-building couch cushions – sparking endless creative play.

  • Master VR Movement: Unleash your inner parkour master! Run, climb, and jump using intuitive VR movement that feels both realistic and exhilarating.

  • Vibrant Claymation Art Style: Immerse yourself in a unique, colorful, and high-resolution claymation world that’s both visually stunning and incredibly performant, even on Quest 2.

  • Mini-Games & Game Modes: Dive into unique mini-games within each park, or simply create your own fun – the choice is yours! "House Rules" adapt to level the playing field, ensuring everyone can join the fun.

A Game For Everyone, From VR Newcomers to Seasoned Players

Clayground is designed to be the perfect first VR experience and a constantly evolving playground for VR veterans.

  • Easy to Pick Up & Play: Intuitive controls and a welcoming atmosphere make Clayground the ideal introduction to VR for friends and family.

  • Endless Replayability: With a growing roster of parks, game modes, features, and a roadmap fueled by player feedback, the fun in Clayground never stops.

  • Safe & Moderated Social Space: Enjoy peace of mind with built-in voice moderation and easy-to-use muting tools, ensuring a safe environment for everyone.

  • Record & Share Your Fun: Capture epic moments with a high-quality spectator view, perfect for creating and sharing gameplay videos with friends and the community.

Free to Play - Jump in Soon!

Three vibrant parks are included for FREE! Want even more playground fun? Expand your experience with the upcoming Fun Parks Bundle, and bring your friends along for free when you're the group host!

Clayground is more than just a game; it's a passion project built by a seasoned VR player who believes in the power of social VR to connect people and create unforgettable moments. Join us in shaping the future of VR play!

name: Clayground

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel i5 7600 3.5 ghz+
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 1070 / 1660TI (6GB VRAM)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
  • VR Support: SteamVR or OpenXR
  • Additional Notes: CPU performance required for physics calculations! SSD Required, 32GB Windows Virtual Memory Cache
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel i7 9700k or greater, 3.6 ghz+
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: 3060ti or greater
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
  • VR Support: SteamVR or OpenXR
  • Additional Notes: CPU performance required for physics calculations! SSD Required, 32GB Windows Virtual Memory Cache

short_description: Welcome to Clayground—the next-gen multiplayer VR experience where imagination knows no bounds! Whether you're a VR veteran or stepping into virtual reality for the first time, Clayground invites you to a playground like no other.
